sources.notes: Actual ImageGen pixels inspected: retain shallow full soft disc, radial sectors and two branched ventral oral tentacles. REJECT the concept dorsal visible anus and its misdrawn gut arrow; only flush projection on dorsal surface, actual anus and mouth underside. Projection geometry follows clockwise path viewed from +Z: mouth/pharynx at angle0 near +X, sweeps decreasing angle through lower hemisphere (broad stomach) then upper hemisphere and terminal narrower intestine toward separate ventral anus. Projection is face-material annotation with zero raised tube geometry. Two oral tentacles below disc project anteriorly enough for oblique hints; supplemental bottom diagnostic separately exposes both dendritic branches and off-centre openings. Radial pleats shallow irregular and continuous, no rigid pie-wedges or shell ribs. No labels in exported geometry; metadata explicitly declares teaching projection.
